bar.text: ...SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT THROUGH WEDNESDAY EVENING... Combined seas 10 to 13 ft, increasing to 14 to 16 ft Wednesday. Bar conditions rough, becoming severe Wednesday. Maximum ebb currents will occur around 400 PM Tuesday, 430 AM Wednesday, and 445 PM Wednesday. The Tuesday and Wednesday afternoon ebbs will be very strong.
bar.seas: 10 to 13 ft, increasing to 14 to 16 ft Wednesday
bar.ebb: afternoon ebbs will be very strong
